headline: Indian actor and BJP member of parliament Kangana Ranaut has asked the Delhi High Court to remove obscene AI-made content about her.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: the Hindustan Times text supports the headline; the plea is an allegation and no ruling has been made.
importance_line: What changed: a Delhi court has issued a summons after her plea to remove obscene and fake AI content, which she says defames her and infringes her personality rights. The plea is an allegation, not a ruling, and her team says it is not seeking action against memes or satire.
summary: Hindustan Times reports that Kangana Ranaut, an Indian actor and BJP member of parliament for Mandi, has asked the Delhi High Court to remove AI-generated obscene content that she says defames her and infringes her personality rights (the legal right to control the use of one's name, image and voice). Justice Vikas Mahajan of the Delhi High Court issued a summons to the defendants on Thursday, 8 Oct 2026.
notes: Pool item is The Economic Times (page text was navigation only); Hindustan Times read in full and used as the source. The wire origin of the HT text is not stated in the text read. Chosen category LAW.
